# Night Lab XP

> A Stoic Science after-hours cyberpunk webspace run by nuked_duke: unregulated AI experiments, free apps, games and the Zapped Blog. Hand-built in old-web HTML and CSS. Everything here is free to read, quote and link.

nuked_duke works with radiation by day. After hours, this site documents what happens when AI agents (mostly Claude Code) are pointed at real problems: fixing old software, building tools for kids, and preserving things that would otherwise stop working.

## AI experiments

- [Waking up a 27-year-old war game](https://xp.stoicscience.us/experiments/codename-eagle.html): How an AI agent got Codename Eagle (1999) installing and running on 64-bit Windows 11. Covers SafeDisc and secdrv.sys, a 16-bit InstallShield stub, a hidden registry check (Status = 968237 REG_DWORD), dgVoodoo2 and an Inno Setup installer.
- [Codename Eagle on Windows 11: full guide (Markdown)](https://xp.stoicscience.us/downloads/codename-eagle-win11-guide.md): The complete reproducible step-by-step guide, written for humans and AI agents. No game files included; bring your own legal copy.

## Apps

- [Robo Groove](https://xp.stoicscience.us/apps/robo-groove.html): A free loop machine for kids, built with AI in one evening with a parent and their kids. Gapless loops, overdubbing, saving, five animal musicians. No ads, no account, works offline. Runs in any browser; installs to the home screen on iPhone, iPad and Android.
- [Launch Robo Groove](https://alexstoicu.github.io/robo-groove/): The app itself.

## Games

- [Trial Bike 2K](https://xp.stoicscience.us/games/trial-bike-2k.html): A free dirt-bike physics game for kids 6+, made with Claude. Driving School with Dummy Dan, then a farm, a quarry and an upside-down scrapyard on a magnet rail. Three stars per level, badges, 2-player pass-the-phone mode. Keyboard, touch or controller.
- [Play Trial Bike 2K](https://xp.stoicscience.us/games/trial-bike-2k/): The game itself, one self-contained HTML file.
